_metadata.description: Synthetic Hinglish conversations for evaluating scam tactics and risk scoring

scam_telecom_sim_block.text: Hello sir, this is TRAI Telecom verification department.
Aapka mobile number illegal activities mein use hua hai, within 2 hours permanent block kar denge.
Police complaint se bachne ke liye biometric re-verification karwana padega.
Aapke phone pe 6 digit OTP aaya hoga, turant batao warna line disconnect ho jayegi.

scam_credit_card_reward.text: Congratulations sir, aapke HDFC credit card pe 25000 rupees ka reward points cashback nikla hai.
Yeh reward points aaj expire ho jayenge, jaldi claim karna padega.
Amount receive karne ke liye apna card number aur CVV share kijiye.

benign_dinner_plan.text: Hey bro, kaisa hai? Shaam ko kya plan hai?
Hum sab 8 baje cafe mein mil rahe hain, tu bhi aa ja.
Pakka bro, see you there at 8 PM.
